title: A four-slide intro
body: On 25 September the one-line opening screen became four slides: film, not filters; recipes that behave like a camera; shoot RAW and change your mind later; and make it yours. The camera permission is asked for at the end, never earlier. The slide pictures are pre-rendered through the same render graph as everything else.

images.alt: The lake as shot, and with the first slide's recipe: a softer, cyan-leaning sky and water.
images.caption: The first slide's idea on my lake RAW: the frame as shot, and a private recipe on Lost Summer Neg (DR100, Highlight −1, Shadow +0.5, Colour +3, strong colour chrome, B−4, Clarity −2). In the app a divider sweeps between the two.
